headline: A durable organization for humans and agents.
lede: Ateles is built toward shared initiative under explicit authority, with each action attributable and each decision reconstructable.

items.label: Available now
items.title: One operator, several agent roles
items.body: The reference system coordinates a single operator's agents through shared state, declared responsibilities, and guarded actions.

items.label: Designed next
items.title: Several accountable people
items.body: The same model extends to distinct human principals, delegated approval, and shared responsibility.

items.label: Long-term promise
items.title: An organization that keeps moving
items.body: Work advances toward shared priorities and returns only the decisions that truly need human judgement.
